files./work/mit-kdc/kdc.conf:
[kdcdefaults]
 kdc_listen = ""
 kdc_tcp_listen = 127.0.0.1:18888
[realms]
 __REALM__ = {
  kdc_listen = ""
  kdc_tcp_listen = 127.0.0.1:18888
  kadmind_listen = ""
  kpasswd_listen = ""
  database_module = synthetic_db
  key_stash_file = /work/mit-kdc/master.stash
  acl_file = /work/mit-kdc/kadm5.acl
  max_life = 120s
  max_renewable_life = 180s
  master_key_type = aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96
  supported_enctypes = aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96:normal
  no_host_referral = *
 }
[dbmodules]
 db_module_dir = /opt/mit/lib/krb5/plugins/kdb
 synthetic_db = {
  db_library = db2
  database_name = /work/mit-kdc/principal
 }
[logging]
 kdc = STDERR
 admin_server = STDERR
 default = STDERR
files./work/mit-kdc/krb5.conf:
[libdefaults]
 default_realm = __REALM__
 dns_lookup_kdc = false
 dns_lookup_realm = false
 dns_uri_lookup = false
 dns_canonicalize_hostname = false
 rdns = false
 canonicalize = false
 udp_preference_limit = 1
 clockskew = 5
 ticket_lifetime = 120s
 renew_lifetime = 180s
 forwardable = false
 proxiable = false
 allow_weak_crypto = false
 default_tkt_enctypes = aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96
 default_tgs_enctypes = aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96
 permitted_enctypes = aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96
 default_ccache_name = FILE:/work/mit-kdc/reader.ccache
 default_keytab_name = FILE:/work/mit-kdc/hdfs.keytab
 default_client_keytab_name = FILE:/work/mit-kdc/reader.keytab
 default_rcache_name = dfl:
 plugin_base_dir = /opt/mit/lib/krb5/plugins
[realms]
 __REALM__ = {
  kdc = 127.0.0.1:18888
 }
[domain_realm]
 127.0.0.1 = __REALM__
[plugins]
 clpreauth = {
  enable_only = encrypted_timestamp
 }
 kdcpreauth = {
  enable_only = encrypted_timestamp
 }
 hostrealm = {
  enable_only = profile
 }
